title: LBJ's secret mission to Prime Minister Sato on textile exports

tellings.quote: LBJ wants you to go on a very secret mission to Tokyo

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former trade adviser to American presidents, says that around 1964 he was told that President Lyndon Johnson wanted him to go on a very secret mission to Tokyo. He says the job was to deal with Japan's Prime Minister, Eisaku Sato, over Japanese textile exports, and he also names the senior official Christian Herter in the story. He tells it to show how close to the top of government he worked, which matters because he also claims to have handled UFO material.
